description: Primary water barriers (primaire keringen) across the Netherlands, showing the 238 dike sections that form the backbone of Dutch flood protection under the Water Act (Waterwet).

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri row id (see generic).

table:columns.name: NAMESPACE
table:columns.description: Namespace of the trajectory identifier; constant 'NL99' (national register) in this dataset.

table:columns.name: TRAJECT_ID
table:columns.description: Dike trajectory id as listed with the statutory flood-protection norms in the Waterwet/Bkl annexes (e.g. '13-5').

table:columns.name: VERSIE
table:columns.description: Version number of the trajectory record in the NBPW (observed values 2-4).

table:columns.name: FL_BEGIN
table:columns.description: Date field; 2016-05-09 on every row (introduction of the 2017 norm trajectories). Exact meaning of the 'FL' prefix is not published.

table:columns.name: FL_EINDE
table:columns.description: Date field, counterpart of FL_BEGIN; null for current records. Exact meaning of 'FL' prefix not published.

table:columns.name: FH_BEGIN
table:columns.description: Date field; varies per trajectory, consistent with the date this record version took effect. Exact meaning of 'FH' prefix not published.

table:columns.name: FH_EINDE
table:columns.description: Date field, counterpart of FH_BEGIN; null for current records. Exact meaning of 'FH' prefix not published.

table:columns.name: NORMGRP_C
table:columns.description: Norm group code; constant '40' in this dataset.

table:columns.name: NORMGRP_O
table:columns.description: Norm group description; constant 'Landelijke normering primaire waterkeringen' (national norm system for primary flood defences).

table:columns.name: NORMKDR_C
table:columns.description: Norm framework code; constant 'WTWT'.

table:columns.name: NORMKDR_O
table:columns.description: Norm framework description; constant 'Waterwet' (the Water Act that anchors the dike norms).

table:columns.name: NORMTYP_ID
table:columns.description: Norm type code: 1 = overstromingskans (flooding probability), 2 = faalkans (failure probability).

table:columns.name: NORMTYP_O
table:columns.description: Norm type description: 'Overstromingskans' or 'Faalkans'.

table:columns.name: NORM_SW
table:columns.description: Signaleringswaarde: statutory signalling value, stored as x meaning a probability of 1/x per year (e.g. 30000 = 1/30,000); exceedance signals reinforcement.

table:columns.name: NORM_OG
table:columns.description: Ondergrens: lower-limit norm (maximum allowed flooding/failure probability), stored as x meaning 1/x per year.

table:columns.name: NORM_THB
table:columns.description: Integer, observed 0 or 10. No public definition found; do not interpret.

table:columns.name: NORM_NS
table:columns.description: Integer, observed 0/10/100/200. No public definition found; do not interpret.

table:columns.name: WET_JN
table:columns.description: Whether the trajectory is anchored in the Waterwet annexes (J/N); 'J' on all rows.

table:columns.name: Shape__Length
table:columns.description: See generic.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded; see proj:epsg for the CRS.
